jamie_release: Quick call — opening canary nominations for Wed 09:30 PST. We need slot owners, smoke owners, and rollback readiness. Drop your slot and short status.

alex_dev: I can take 09:30-09:45 for svc-search changes (small model pin + cache tweak). smoke owner: @olivia_qe. rollback plan: tag v1.4.3-roll ready. PR review by EOD.

olivia_qe: I'll take smoke for search. I'll run smoke script and a quick perf sweep. pls post canary endpoint and any seed prompts.

mike_sre: I'm oncall that window, can execute rollback if needed. recommend rollout ramp: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m waits. Also add prom alert for token_latency > 2s and error_rate > 0.5%.

jamie_release: Thanks team. alex, add readiness probe change to PR. olivia, smoke checklist (short):
```
./scripts/smoke.sh --endpoint $CANARY_URL --checks basic,latency,errors
# verify: 1) 95th latency < 1s on 1k sample 2) no 5xx 3) kv cache hit rate >= 60%
```
mike_sre: Also make sure the rollout policy in Console has fallback to the last stable model and a canary timeout set to 20m.

deploy-bot: slot_reserved: 09:30-09:45 reserved for alex_dev — ticket INF-4234 created (link: https://tracker.redwood/infr/4234)

chris_pm: FYI there's a customer demo at 11:00 — canary needs to be green or we'll postpone. I'll be watching.

alex_dev: Noted. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/321 — adding label `release-0903-canary` and the rollback tag.

jamie_release: Great. I'll publish final roster tomorrow morning and create the rollout in Console. :thumbsup:
